record.name: Monday.com
record.one_liner: A work operating system and AI work platform that helps teams run projects, workflows, and collaboration.
record.access_note: Developers can create a free developer account or sign up for the free plan to obtain API credentials.
record.api_note: An expressive GraphQL API to interact with workflows, automate processes, and power integrations.

evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
If you don't have a monday.com account yet, create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.
An expressive GraphQL API to interact with your workflows, automate processes, power integrations, and more!
The `@mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp` package provides a plug-and-play server implementation for the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

flags_before.detail: quote not in cited source: developer account on a free, no expiration date developer account!
